author: ValWood
body:
Yeast have γ-glutamyl transpeptidase, but it is for glutathione metabolism, not leukotriene metabolism.

They do not appear to have the mammalian leukotriene C4–specific γ-glutamyl transferase (i.e., the enzyme that converts LTC₄ ↔ LTD₄).

Querying
